questions.question: Combine the January-May timesheets and clean them (headers, dates, codes, hours, Total/blank rows, duplicates, unknown codes), then merge Employees and Labour_Rates. One Week Ending has a typo year 2062; correct it to 2026. Overtime rule: for each employee and Week Ending, hours above 37.5 are overtime, counted AFTER removing duplicates and unknown-code rows. Each line gets its share of that overtime in proportion to its hours. Labour cost per line = Hours x Standard Rate + that line's OT hours x Standard Rate x (OT Multiplier - 1). What is the total labour cost for CL-P103 for Jan-Mar (month of Week Ending)?
questions.definition: Labour Cost per line = Hours x Standard Rate + OT Hours(line) x Standard Rate x (OT Multiplier - 1). Weekly Hours = sum of an employee's hours for a Week Ending (after removing unknown-code rows and duplicates). OT Hours(line) = max(0, Weekly Hours - 37.5) x Hours / Weekly Hours (pro-rata by hours). Month = month of Week Ending. Rounded to 2dp at the end.
questions.how: Folder combine with fnLoadTimesheet, Remove Duplicates, drop unknown codes, merge Employees (Grade) and Labour_Rates, Group By Employee+Week for Weekly Hours, add OT Hours and Labour Cost, filter CL-P103 & Jan-Mar, sum.

trap_answers.year_2062_not_fixed: affects May weeks only for the month grouping; Q6 (Jan-Mar) unchanged

questions.question: Compare loaded hours per month (after cleaning and removing duplicates, BEFORE removing unknown project codes) with Control_Totals.xlsx. Which month fails and by how many hours, and why?
questions.answer: Feb: loaded 7.5 hours MORE than control (3006.5 vs 2999.0); explained by 6 unknown-code rows
questions.definition: Per-month sum of Hours of the deduped table (Week Ending month) minus 'System Hours' in Control_Totals.xlsx. Control = clean truth hours for valid projects. Only Feb is non-zero: +7.5 hours (also +6 lines) = the six rows booked to CL-P199 (4 rows) and CL-P100 (2 rows).
questions.how: Group deduped table by Month; merge with Control; Difference = Loaded - System; then Left Anti merge with Projects to see the 6 rows (7.5 h) that explain it.

trap_answers.unknown_codes_removed_before_control_che: every month shows difference 0.0 (Feb looks fine, the discrepancy is hidden); loaded Feb = 2999.0 = control

questions.question: Build the roll-forward with a Period parameter. Check Month 10 (Bfwd 250,000.00 / Additions 10,000.00 / Disposals (25,000.00) / Write offs 0 / Cfwd 235,000.00). Then copy Asset_Movements_2026-11.xlsx from _Later into 05_Budget_Assets, set Period = 11 and refresh. (The 1 January opening cost per asset class is on the Opening_Cost sheet of Asset_Movements_2026.xlsx.) What is Cost Cfwd for Month 11?
questions.definition: Cost Bfwd(period) = opening cost at 1 Jan 2026 (238,000.00) + all Additions - Disposals - Write offs in earlier periods. Cost Cfwd = Bfwd + Additions - Disposals - Write offs for the period, all four asset classes combined. Month 11: Bfwd 235,000.00, Additions 28,700.00, Disposals (900.00), Write offs (600.00).
questions.how: Combine movement files, Fill Down Asset Class, remove subtotal rows, clean text numbers, filter Period < p and = p, add up.

questions.question: Combine the three card statements, keep Posted rows only, dedupe on Bank Ref, and match to Employees on Last Four (restore leading zeros: 937 becomes 0937). Amount rule: if Amount is blank or 0, use Original Currency Amount x the rate in FX_Rates.xlsx (GBP = 1.00); an amount ending 'CR' is a refund and must be negative. What is the total GBP spend (net of refunds) for Callum Reid using the transaction Date (not the Posted date) in February 2026?
questions.definition: Sum of Amount GBP where Date is in Feb 2026 and Employees.Card Last Four (4 digits, leading zeros restored) maps to the cardholder. Amount GBP = statement Amount, or if blank/0: Original Currency Amount x rate (GBP 1.00, USD 0.79, EUR 0.86). 'CR' amounts are negative. Pending rows removed; duplicates by Bank Ref removed (keep first).
questions.how: lab6_cards.m; filter Employee Name and Month = Feb, sum Amount GBP.

trap_answers.note_leading_zeros: Cardholders with a leading-zero card: Priya Nair (0937) and Aisha Rahman (0184); 63 rows would fail to match. Callum Reid has no leading zero, so this trap does not change Q19 (it changes their totals and Q20).
